models.composition: Hercules and Nessus — Uffizi Antique Group with Renaissance Restorations
models.qualification: Native preflight required; reject substantial capture loss. Scaniverse capture published by JFN (db4), including the display pedestal. The publisher’s text misattributes the group to Giambologna; the museum’s primary record and the captured composition identify the Uffizi antique/Caccini group. Upper capture coverage requires priority native inspection.

models.composition: Fountain of the Four Parts of the World (Observatory Fountain)
models.qualification: Adult museum/public-art figure. Native front/above/reverse preflight mandatory; skip major missing surfaces. Full fountain capture includes surrounding basin. Carpeaux modeled the four adult women; Frémiet the animals, Legrain the sphere, Villeminot the ornament, and Davioud the architecture. Museum monument inventory dates bronze casting to 1873 and installation to 1874. Reduced-resolution photogrammetry from more than 300 photographs; inspect figures closely for readability.

Adult museum/public-art figure. Native front/above/reverse preflight mandatory; skip major missing surfaces. Copenhagen fountain bronze, distinct from the later Horsens example. City archive catalog identifies Artemis (1934) in Hans Tavsensgades Park, Copenhagen; city acceptance letter dated 1936. Source thumbnail shows complete main group, but fine antlers and bow require native inspection.
